full_judgment: The same view also emanated from the House of Lords in Connely-v-DPP (1964 AC 1254 HL) and from the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (1950 AC 458), in Sambasivam-v-Public Prosecutor, Malayasia, in Dhirubhan Madaribhai-v-state of Gkujrat (1998(1) Crime, 570 Guy-D B), where it has been categorically observed that an order of acquittal has retrospective effect from the date of judgment of the trial court.
